title: Tissue Dissociation Protocol for Pan Immune Project Tissue
author: Lira Mamanova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ymzfu76
materials: Chop tissues into small pieces, weigh

steps.title: Prepare Tissue for Dissociation
steps.instruction: Place tissue into a Miltenyi C tube with liberase/DNase solution.

substeps.instruction: Add <5.0g of tissue per Miltenyi C tube

steps.title: Perform Mechanical Dissociation
steps.instruction: Process the tissue using a GentleMACS Octo dissociator.

steps.title: Wash and Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the dissociated cells with PBS and centrifuge to pellet.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the resulting pellet in PBS

steps.title: Isolate Mononuclear Cells (MNCs)
steps.instruction: Perform density gradient centrifugation using Ficoll.

substeps.instruction: Layer the cell suspension onto Ficoll
Spin at room temperature (RT) at 400g for 25 minutes
Remove MNCs from the Ficoll layer
Wash the recovered MNCs with PBS

steps.title: Filter Cells
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 0.2uM filter.

steps.title: Count and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Determine cell viability and prepare cells for 10X loading.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells at a concentration of 1000/uL in 10X buffer (chilled PBS + 0.05% FBS)
